name: EveryDev.ai

sources.title: Homepage — AI developer social network + directory of 2,100+ tools; 'Submit a Tool' at /create/tool
Submit-a-tool route — auth-gated; 'It's all free' sign-in via GitHub or Google

requirements: Free account required — sign in with GitHub or Google to access /create/tool
Tool should serve AI developers: categories span coding assistants, agent frameworks, MCP servers, prompt tools, vibe-coding, design, database, testing, LLM evals
Directory has community reviews/ratings and per-tool discussion threads — expect public feedback
preparation: GitHub or Google account for sign-in
Tool name, URL, description, topic/category fit
Optionally plan follow-ups: a Build showcase (/create/build), discussion, or blog post amplifies the listing
workflow: Sign in at https://www.everydev.ai/ (GitHub or Google OAuth)
Open https://www.everydev.ai/create/tool and submit the tool details
Once listed, the tool gets a directory page eligible for community ratings, reviews, and discussion threads
Optionally create a Build post to showcase the product in the community feed
watchFor: This is a community platform, not just a form dump — low-effort listings without engagement will sit unrated
An 'Advertise' program exists separately for paid reach
Community reviews are 'hands-on experiences, not marketing copy' — expect scrutiny of overclaimed features
Form fields not visible without signing in
countsAsLive: The tool appears in the everydev.ai/tools directory with a public detail page open to community reviews
unknowns: Whether submissions undergo manual review before appearing
Turnaround between submission and public listing
